Name: Compliance by TwelveLabs
Tagline: Video compliance review powered by rules you control
Description: Compliance by TwelveLabs is a SaaS application that reviews your video library against rules your team writes, not ours. It ingests footage, applies your own compliance rule packs, and returns reviewer-ready findings with context, not just a timestamp and a label. Powered by TwelveLabs' Pegasus model, it explains why a moment may violate a rule so reviewers can accept, reject, or annotate in one queue.

Name: GPT-6 Astra
Tagline: OpenAI's most capable model for end-to-end work
Description: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's most capable model for complex reasoning, software engineering, computer use, science, and professional work. Async tool calling and mid-turn steering help it run multistep agent workflows. API: model id gpt-6-astra, $10/$50 per 1M tokens (short context). Rolling out first via Trusted Access/Daybreak, then Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and the API in the coming days. First OpenAI model at the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold (advanced cyber access limited).

Name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
Tagline: Most intelligent workhorse yet for coding and agents
Description: Gemini 3.8 Flash is Google's most intelligent workhorse yet. Third Flash drop in 6 weeks, with big jumps from 3.7 on software engineering, agents, and multi-step reasoning. It sits with larger frontier models on DeepSWE v1.1 for long-horizon coding, leads Terminal-bench 2.1 at 89.4% and HLE-Verified at 54.9%, and ships at the same intro price as 3.7: $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens through Dec 31. Live today in the Gemini app (Pro/Ultra), AI Studio, Antigravity, Gemini Enterprise, and the API.

Name: myAIcademy
Tagline: Learn AI skills for your specific role and team
Description: myAIcademy builds personalized AI training around your role, goals, and the tools you actually use. Learn through follow-along lessons, practice safely with simulations of real AI tools, and get step-by-step guidance from Aimy while you work. Generic courses and prompt libraries that quickly go stale, while myAIcademy continuously refreshes its content as AI changes, so your skills keep up too.

Name: cmmnts
Tagline: Add a powerful comment section to any website
Description: Adding comments to your website shouldn’t require building a comment system from scratch. cmmnts gives you everything you need for discussions—threads, moderation, login, anonymous comments, Markdown, mentions, emoji, and GIFs. Drop it into your site and start collecting comments.

Name: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Cyber
Tagline: Next-gen Gemini for agents, reasoning, and cyber security
Description: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber bring next-generation intelligence to agentic workflows and cybersecurity. Built for long-horizon coding, multi-step reasoning, autonomous tasks, and vulnerability detection, they deliver stronger performance at Flash speed and low cost.

Name: Omarchy
Tagline: The malleable OS for the age of agents
Description: Omarchy is an omakase Linux desktop on Arch, Hyprland, and Quickshell. It ships a complete keyboard-first workstation with system-wide themes, packaged updates, and coding agents that can reshape the setup instead of making you assemble it yourself.

Name: WeatherNext 3
Tagline: Our most advanced and accurate global weather AI model
Description: Our flagship AI weather forecasting model now includes real-time satellite data, hourly refreshes, higher resolution, precise precipitation forecasting, and clean energy variables. It’s now integrated across Search, Gemini, Maps, Google Maps Platform, and Cloud.

Name: TrackMCP
Tagline: Google Analytics for MCP Servers
Description: TrackMCP shows who is using your MCP server, what they are trying to do, whether the work gets done, and where to improve. All from one line of code.

Name: Offline JS Playground
Tagline: Write, run, and test JavaScript snippets & JSON offline
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Productivity, Developer Tools, Vibe coding
Description: A simple playground to write, run, and test JavaScript snippets, with an in-UI console. Built for quick experiments, debugging, learning, testing ideas, and working with JavaScript without needing a full development environment. This tool is offline by design, providing a robust JavaScript playground directly within Chrome.

Name: sidebranch
Tagline: Easy git-based visual diffing
Description: Review PRs from inside your running app: switch branches from an in-page widget and compare worktrees side by side. Loopback-only, zero dependencies.

Name: Chalked for Mac
Tagline: Your replies ready with your work's full context
Description: Chalked is the reply layer for Mac. Open a supported conversation and it prepares what you would actually say from the visible thread, live calendar and sourced working context. Press Tab to insert, hold fn to change the intended outcome by voice, then review and send yourself. Accepted or edited communication can become inspectable evidence, so later replies start smarter. Voice is optional. Nothing auto-sends.

Name: Snitch
Tagline: Your Slack org chart, built by everyone in it.
Description: Snitch asks everyone in your Slack one question, who do you report to, and builds the org chart from the answers. Then it answers questions about it: reporting chains, team sizes, who owns what. No HR system, nothing for you to fill in.

Name: Clockwork
Tagline: The calendar where your AI agents show up for work
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Book AI coding agents on a real calendar. Clockwork runs them unattended in sandboxed git worktrees on your Mac, pauses for approval when something looks risky, and files a report with the actual dollar cost. Bring your own key or ride your existing subscription. Schedule recurring agent jobs on a real calendar, run them unattended in isolated sandboxes, and review honest reports.

Name: Inline
Tagline: A thread-based chat app for work with your team and agents
Description: Inline is a thread-based chat app for all work, with your team and agents.

Name: Email Health Check by Truelist
Tagline: Grade your email list's health in 30 seconds, free
Description: Upload any CSV and get a real-time health report: an overall grade plus the Ok / Risky / Catch-all / Invalid breakdown, checked live against actual mail servers. Free, no signup, no email-gated report. Runs on the Truelist engine — 1B+ emails validated.

Name: Trailmarks iOS
Tagline: Real World Travel Quiz & Trivia Adventure
Description: Trailmarks is a travel trivia game built on the real world. You answer true-or-false questions about the city you're in, then spend the rewards on a ticket out, limited by what the departure board offers and what you can afford. Your score is the kilometers behind you. The routes are real: flights that exist, trains where there are tracks, boats across oceans. 1000+ cities. iPhone only, $4.99 once, no ads, no account, plays fully offline.

Name: ALIA
Tagline: The data infrastructure for AI that speaks Africa
Description: ALIA is the platform to collect, annotate, validate, and evaluate high-quality datasets for African languages and cultures. Organizations launch data projects; contributors earn rewards through missions on web and Telegram.

Name: Murf Falcon 2
Tagline: Fastest, most-natural TTS at $0.01/minute
Description: Falcon 2 is Murf's real-time text-to-speech model for voice agents, priced at $0.01/min, a fifth the cost of comparable models. Sub-100ms time-to-first-byte across 32 global edge locations, ranked among the top real-time natural-sounding models on every independent voice benchmark it appears on. 150+ voices across 35+ languages, switching mid-sentence. Powers AI receptionists, call centers, support and conversational AI use cases at 10,000 concurrent calls with on-prem deployment.

Name: SCRUB.
Tagline: Run creator campaigns across platforms, end to end
Description: Scrub brings brands, creators, and creator tech together in one platform. Brands can discover and run campaigns with creators of any size — from 50 followers to 500K+. Creators can discover brand opportunities and get paid for their content, regardless of audience size. From discovery and campaign management to automation, tracking, and integrations, Scrub brings the entire creator marketing workflow into one place.
